newsitem.title: UK: LPC-Russia's Rossisky Kredit said to sign loan.
newsitem.headline: LPC-Russia's Rossisky Kredit said to sign loan.

text.p: LONDON, Sep 11 (LPC) - Russia's Rossisky Kredit Bank signed yesterday a $21 million syndicated bank loan, according to a banker involved in the deal.
The loan has a 180 day final maturity and is priced 550 bps over LIBOR. A total of 13 banks comprise the syndicate.

Russian banks are turning for funding to the syndicated loan market in increasing numbers. Industry and Construction Bank is currently seeking to raise $20 million in a 180 day deal priced 550 bps over LIBOR and Tokobank is in market seeking $30 million for one year with a margin of 450 bps.
